features.title: Compact yet capacious, Treo and Duo pedestals maximize under-desk space, blending functionality with sleek design. It's ideal for individuals who need everyday access to files and personal belongings.
Built with robust all-metal frames, this powder-coated metal construction ensures long-term durability while maintaining a professional, modern finish.
A compact pedestal designed for efficient under-desk placement, ideal for space-conscious offices.
Designed with a cam lock system that provides everyday security for confidential files and valuables. It keeps personal items safe in shared offices, reducing risks of unauthorized access.
Choose between box-file and triple drawer layouts to match your personal storage style. Drawer configurations adapt to your needs, whether storing files, stationery, or essentials.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Duo 2-Drawer Desk Storage
